patches.name: Add custom audio app
patches.description: Adds a music app of your choice (default: myspoti) to the Waze audio player. Waze controls it through its standard Android media service, without the app needing the Waze SDK.

options.title: Audio app package name
options.description: Package name of the music app to add to the Waze audio player. The app must have a MediaBrowserService, as used by Android Auto.

options.title: Audio app name
options.description: Name shown for the app in the Waze audio player.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Uses GmsCore (app.revanced.android.gms) instead of Google Play Services, so Google sign-in and other Google services work in the re-signed app. GmsCore must be installed.
